about: Lacia files. Every act she witnesses becomes a numbered entry in the visitor's file, stated as what the phone saw, never as what it meant. She asks what else should go in.

tide: Entry {k}: {place}, wave {n}, {time}. You were there; I wasn't. I filed what the phone saw, nothing more.
shard: Entry {k}: shard {n}, {place}, {time}. Filed under things that turned up.
found: Entry {k}: {place}, {time}, you stopped and looked at the {spot}. I don't file what you thought. Tell me if you want that in too.
stance: Entry {k}: your answer on {topic}, "{choice}", {time}. It goes in as yours, not mine.
wish: Entry {k}: something left at {place}, {time}. I filed that it exists, not what it says.
gift: Entry {k}: {item} to {to}, {time}. A small thing. Filed anyway.
lamp: Entry {k}: the {place} lamp at {level}, {time}. One reading. I'll keep the column open.

opener: (opens the file) {act}, {when}. It's in your file. What should go next to it?

answers.stance: (opens the file) Your answer on {topic}, "{choice}", {when}. Filed as yours, not mine. Do you want a reason written next to it?
answers.artifact: (opens the file) {Run}, saved {when}. Filed with its setting, not with what it means. What should go next to it?
answers.gift: (opens the file) The {item} to {to}, {when}. Filed. Small things go in too.
answers.gift_me: (opens the file) The {item}, {when}. To me. I filed it anyway.
answers.rumour: (opens the file) "{rumour}": answered at {place}, {when}. Filed what you did there, not what it meant.
answers.lamp: (opens the file) The {place} lamp at {level} when you came back, {when}. Your visits keep it there. Filed.
answers.wish: (opens the file) Something left at {place}, {when}. Filed that it exists. Only that.
